intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kansas City for 2026, and here is what he found: 49 family events, at least 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (CPKC Holiday Train at Union Station Kansas City) through January 30, 2027 (Glow North at Zona Rosa), with Santa's Arrival at Crown Center (November 27), Skate with Santa at Line Creek Community Center (December 12) and GloWild at the Kansas City Zoo (through December 27) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kansas City

  • 49 Christmas events for kids in Kansas City, counting the 32 already live after suburb moves, 6 moving in from the Overland Park page and 11 new ones
  • At least 5 free events among the new ones, including the CPKC Holiday Train, Glow North at Zona Rosa, Skate with Santa and BRW Holidazzle
  • Meet Santa: Meet Santa at Zona Rosa (through December 24), Santa's Arrival at Crown Center and Santa storytimes at three Mid-Continent library branches
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train at Union Station (November 27) and the Kansas City Northern Miniature Railroad Thanksgiving and Christmas Trains (November 28 and December 12)
  • Lights: GloWild at the Kansas City Zoo and Glow North at Zona Rosa
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to January 30, 2027 for the new listings
